taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: Drawn as a forb on the herb program: Abrams (1944 p. 412) gives Luetkea as "Cespitose woody plants, with prostrate or decumbent stoloniferous branches", a mat of short leafy shoots about 5-15 cm high, which the herb program draws as many low, outward-leaning stems. No Rosaceae forb is built in, so its template is spreading phlox (phlox-diffusa), another mat.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "Flowering shoots 5-15 cm. high, leafy".

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "Cespitose woody plants"; semi-woody, a mat of slender woody-based shoots.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "Cespitose woody plants".

traits.stem_posture.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "with prostrate or decumbent stoloniferous branches".

traits.clonal.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "often forming mats", from "stoloniferous branches" (genus, p. 412).

traits.rosette.note: Leaves crowded along the short shoots, with no basal rosette, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 248882149, 235278907, 235284059, 388106402, 385828507, 236858631, 376772951, 377636425): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "Leaves twice or thrice ternately dissected", borne singly; alternate, as Rosaceae's are (key, p. 408: "Leaves alternate; herbs or shrubs").

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "Leaves twice or thrice ternately dissected".

traits.division_pattern.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "ternately dissected": three divisions from one point.

traits.division_order.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "twice or thrice ternately dissected"; drawn twice.

traits.leaflets.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "ternately dissected": three divisions at each order.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "Leaves dissected into linear acute divisions, grooved above, 1-1.5 cm. long".

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: the last divisions 3 mm to 6 mm long, a third to a half of the 1-1.5 cm leaf, as in the photos.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "dissected into linear acute divisions".

traits.leaf_apex.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "linear acute divisions".

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: shoots "glabrous or sparsely pilose"; leaves "glabrate".

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "raceme narrow, 1-5 cm. long".

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "raceme narrow, 1-5 cm. long".

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Luetkea: "Inflorescences terminal, 5–20(–30)-flowered, racemes".

traits.flower_merosity.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "sepals and petals 5".

traits.petal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "petals white, round-obovate, 3-3.5 mm. long".

traits.petal_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "petals white, round-obovate".

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "sepals ovate, acute, 2 mm. long".

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Luetkea: "Flowers 3–6 mm diam.".

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "petals white"; sRGB by eye from the photos (creamy white, the stamens yellowish).

traits.stamens.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "stamens about 20, their filaments subulate".

traits.carpels.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "Pistils usually 5, distinct".

traits.fruit_type.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 412, Luetkea: "Follicles coriaceous, dehiscent on both sutures".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 413, Luetkea pectinata: "follicles about 4 mm. long".

generator.params.note: Set by hand for partridgefoot from Abrams's description and the photos the traits cite, on spreading phlox's (phlox-diffusa) structure: many short, leafy shoots leaning out from a mat, the leaves largest low on each shoot, and half of them ending in a narrow raceme of about 15 white flowers on a bare stalk (Abrams 1944 p. 413). Not fitted to measurements. flowers corrected from 15 (spreading phlox's, whose flowers stand singly along the shoot) to 1: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Luetkea: "Inflorescences terminal, 5–20(–30)-flowered, racemes": one raceme ends each flowering shoot.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a bright green mat of finely dissected, fan-like leaves, from which short stalks rise with narrow spikes of creamy white flowers. Organ cards from spreading phlox's (phlox-diffusa), recoloured and resized by hand. Colours set by eye were written as screen (sRGB) shades; they are read as the linear light a colour field holds, and bark and foliage follow the stated colour traits by rule (2026-10-19).

allometry.note: 0.1 m tall at 4 years in the open, within its sources' range, as it grows in subalpine parkland. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Luetkea pectinata: "petiole 5–10 mm, narrowly winged".
